The revised screen is ready at **http://maker:4001** (same page, refresh it).

**Flow 1 (revised) — saving with real page details.** Please do this:

1. **Paste a link and click Save.** Instead of adding it straight away, a small panel appears showing the details the app pulled from the page — a **title, description, preview image, and site icon**.
2. **Change the title** (and description if you like) right there, then click **Add to bookmarks.**

Watch that the saved entry now shows the **icon + title, a description, a preview thumbnail, and the full address underneath** — and that clicking the **title** opens the original page in a new tab.

What I decided here, please confirm each:
- **A quick review step before saving** — I chose to show the fetched details in an editable panel so you can correct the title/description *at save time*, rather than saving instantly then editing. Is that extra step welcome, or would you rather it save instantly and you edit only if needed?
- **The preview image** is shown as a **thumbnail to the left** of each entry.

Once you're happy with the saved entry, I'll have you try two more things: **editing an entry afterward** (the "Edit" link on it), and the **duplicate case** — re-saving a link you already have should jump you to the existing entry, opened for editing, instead of adding a copy.
